definitions.explanation: The basic jump-rope technique in which the rope is swung forward, from behind the body to the front, as the jumper hops over it. The default technique taught first and the most common form of jump-rope practice in Japan.

examples.japanese: {前|まえ}{跳|と}びを⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
⟦{縄跳|なわと}び→縄跳び：06323_nawatobi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}{跳|と}びは⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧だ。
examples.english: The forward jump is the basic jump-rope technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{前|まえ}{跳|と}びを⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧{百回|ひゃっかい}⟦{跳|と}ぶ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧をした。
examples.english: In P.E. class, we practiced doing a hundred consecutive forward jumps.

notes:
{前|まえ}{跳|と}び is the standard jump-rope technique: the rope is swung forward, over the head and under the feet, as the jumper hops in place. It is the first technique taught to children and, unless another type is specified, the default meaning of "jumping rope."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ{跳|と}び→後ろ跳び：30928_ushirotobi⟧: backward jump
- ⟦{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}び→交差跳び：30929_kousatobi⟧: cross jump
- ⟦{片足|かたあし}{跳|と}び→片足跳び：30930_kataashitobi⟧: single-leg jump

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {前|まえ}{跳|と}びをする: to do forward jumps
- {前|まえ}{跳|と}びで{百回|ひゃっかい}⟦{跳|と}ぶ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧: to jump a hundred times using the forward-jump technique
